ITEM 1 | Dense mound of dark green leafy greens, flat broad leaves with paler green midribs and some thin stems, slightly glossy and moist-looking, covering roughly 40% of a square white plate about 20 cm across, piled about 4-5 cm high at center, leaves tender and holding shape loosely | 60
ITEM 2 | Scattered small golden-tan granular pieces, roughly 0.3-0.5 cm each, irregular crumbly texture, dry-looking, sitting among and beside the greens and on the plate surface, about 6-8 pieces total | 3
ITEM 3 | Few small bright red flecks, roughly 0.3 cm, possibly dried chili or pepper pieces, dry and firm, one near the top-left edge of the greens | 1
